basics.name: Priyank Saxena
basics.title: Software Engineer
basics.summary: Software Engineer specializing in automation, DevOps workflows, and enterprise endpoint remediation across Windows and macOS environments. Experienced in designing and implementing one-click troubleshooters, silent software installers, and  Microsoft Update metadata and patch intelligence pipelines. Proficient in Python, PowerShell, Bash, C#, Selenium, Pandas, and data analytics to automate diagnostics, root-cause analysis, and operational workflows, reducing manual effort and improving endpoint reliability and system stability within large-scale IT environments.

description: Progressed from Trainee Engineer to Software Engineer, contributing to enterprise endpoint support, troubleshooting, automation, and IT service operations.
Developed 100+ one-click endpoint troubleshooters and 50+ silent software installers for Windows environments, reducing manual support effort and MTTR.
Built 40+ macOS remediation solutions using Bash and CLI tools to support cross-platform enterprise environments.
Designed 20+ automation troubleshooters for the Root Cause Analysis (RCA) module, improving issue resolution accuracy and system reliability.
Created metadata-driven automation pipelines for patch intelligence, validation, and reporting.
Actively contributed to research, development, and automation initiatives, enhancing product capabilities and extending the reach of key features.
Maintained detailed technical documentation and SOPs for enterprise automation workflows.
Provided dedicated technical services and performed data analysis for HP-DAAS PI as part of service delivery for Lupin Limited, resolving issues efficiently and maintaining client satisfaction.
Gained hands-on experience in scripting, system diagnostics, deployment, monitoring, and validation of automated solutions.

projects.name: Troubleshooter Module - Remediation & Automation Scripts
description: Engineered large-scale endpoint remediation automation using 200+ scripts developed with PowerShell, Bash, C#, and CLI tools.
Delivered client-specific recommendations and 150+ silent software installers, significantly reducing support tickets.
Contributed to continuous improvement of automated diagnostics and remediation workflows.
highlights: Cross-platform automation across Windows and macOS
Reduced manual troubleshooting and support effort

projects.name: Microsoft Update Metadata Automation Engine
description: Designed and developed a Python-based metadata automation engine to scrape, process, filter, and analyze Microsoft Update Catalog data.
Implemented query-based scraping using Selenium and BeautifulSoup, enabling automated and targeted collection of Microsoft update metadata.
Built data transformation and reporting pipelines using Pandas and OpenPyXL to convert raw catalog data into structured patch intelligence.
Developed a fully functional web-based UI with Flask, providing analytical dashboards, metadata filtering, query-driven scraping, and administrative operations.
Integrated Supabase as a live cloud database for persistent storage and management of patch metadata.
Implemented administrative capabilities for metadata configuration, deletion, filtering, and operational management through the application interface.
Automated the monthly Microsoft update metadata collection process, reducing manual effort and improving the speed and consistency of patch intelligence generation.

impact: Reduced manual effort involved in recurring Microsoft monthly update metadata collection.
Improved the speed, consistency, and accessibility of patch intelligence data for enterprise patch management.
Enabled centralized analysis and operational management of patch metadata through a single web-based platform.

projects.name: Lupin Enterprise IT Solutions – HP DAAS & Workelevate
description: Served as Report Administrator and PI Analyst for the HP DAAS environment supporting Lupin, performing system reliability, Digital Employee Experience (DEX), and IT workflow analysis.
Analyzed endpoint and service data to identify recurring issues, operational trends, and improvement opportunities, providing technical recommendations for troubleshooting and resolution.
Built and maintained dashboards and analytical reports to monitor endpoint health, service performance, DEX metrics, and IT operational workflows.
Worked on a Driver Upgrade Automation Framework for HP devices to streamline driver update and endpoint maintenance workflows.
Contributed to the integration of the Workelevate platform with enterprise servers, chatbot APIs, and ITSM systems to enable automated workflows and service operations.
Worked on making the Workelevate chatbot and administrative console functional by supporting API integrations, workflow configuration, testing, and operational enhancements.

projects.name: AIRO — Attendance Intelligence & Recognition Operations
description: Developed a full-stack facial-recognition attendance system using Python, Flask, OpenCV, Scikit-learn, Supabase, JavaScript, and Plotly to automate employee identification and attendance marking.
Implemented a computer-vision pipeline using Haar Cascade for face detection and distance-weighted KNN classification with up to 5 neighbors, operating on normalized 50×50 face representations.
Built browser-based real-time camera recognition using JavaScript getUserMedia(), removing dependency on server-side webcams and enabling cloud deployment.
Integrated Supabase PostgreSQL, Storage, and Authentication for employee profiles, biometric face samples, attendance records, and secure administrator access with private biometric storage.
Implemented automated daily attendance processing, database-level duplicate prevention, interactive Plotly analytics, storage-utilization tracking, and CSV export capabilities.
Designed a responsive AI command-center interface with glassmorphism styling, live camera and recognition status indicators, and analytical dashboards.
Structured the application architecture to support future migration from traditional KNN-based recognition to CNN and deep face-embedding models.

projects.name: Kubernetes GitOps & Observability Platform
description: Deployed and managed a containerized microservices application on Kubernetes using Kind, configuring Pods, Deployments, Services, and cluster resources.
Implemented GitOps-based continuous delivery using Argo CD, managing Kubernetes configurations declaratively through Git.
Used Helm for Kubernetes application packaging, configuration management, and repeatable deployments.
Integrated Prometheus and Grafana for metrics collection, Kubernetes workload monitoring, resource utilization analysis, and observability dashboards.
Configured AWS inbound access and security rules and used Kubernetes port-forwarding for controlled application access, testing, and troubleshooting.
Troubleshot Kubernetes workloads, services, containers, and connectivity using kubectl, container logs, Kubernetes events, and monitoring metrics.
